claims.how: Portia fimbriata principal eye resolves 12.5 cycles per degree (R12), with R1 giving 12.4 by the same route.

quotes.quote: The highest value of the spatial resolving power (Nyquist frequency) of the principle eyes of jumping spiders, such as Portia fimbriata Doleschell, 1859, is 12.5 cycles/degree

The highest spatial frequency that can be recon- structed by layer 1 with minimum receptor-row spacing 1.4 J..Lm and distance 1,980 J..Lm from the posterior nodal point of the telephoto system is 1,980/2.8 = 710 rad- 1.
